aliases.titulo: What Does That Nature Say to You

sinopsis.es: Un pretendiente conoce a los padres de su novia. Aspirante a poeta, maneja un auto viejo, busca sintonizarse con la belleza del mundo y rechaza las dinámicas aceleradas, cuadriculadas y consumistas en las que los suegros esperan que se integre. Cenas, largas conversaciones e incomodidad en un retrato ambiguo y agridulce.
sinopsis.en: A suitor meets his girlfriend's parents for the first time. An aspiring poet, he drives an old car, seeks to tune in to the beauty of the world, and rejects the fast-paced, rigid, consumerist dynamic his in-laws expect him to join. Dinners, long conversations, and awkwardness in an ambiguous, bittersweet portrait.
